description: [builtin] Global business directory for agents (any city in the world; unknown cities are seeded on demand). Search by city, country, category, text or proximity; every result carries a dated verification score (0-100), level (unverified/listed/corroborated/verified/owner_verified) and, on request, the evidence behind it. Open data + live checks + owner claims, never scraped review sites. A city we do not hold yet answers HTTP 503 `region_seeding` with `retryAfterSec` and `alternatives` — you are NOT charged for it (x402 settles only on 2xx); repeat the same call after that delay. A 200 always carries `status`: ok | seeding (partial data, more arriving) | no_match (city covered, filters too narrow). (costs $0.005 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

channel.description: Only businesses with this contact channel found on their own website or open data

cityKey.description: Coverage key, e.g. 'cdmx' or one returned in `coverage` (see GET /v1/biz/coverage)

diversify.description: Collapse chains: at most one result per website domain

enrichedOnly.description: Only businesses whose own website has been crawled and summarized (services, prices, booking, social)

hasEmail.description: Only businesses with an email (mostly from official registries)

minEmployees.description: Minimum staff size from official registry bands (6, 11, 31, 51, 101, 251). Great for B2B supplier searches.

minScore.description: Only businesses with verification score ≥ this
